title: 36 Hours in Berlin
abstract: The Berlin Wall may have fallen 20 years ago next month, but in certain pockets of the German capital, the city is still divided — on whether the Iron Curtain was cool.

title: 36 Hours in Richmond, Va.
abstract: The city is strutting with confidence, moving beyond its Civil War legacy and emerging as a new player on the Southern art and culinary scene.

title: 36 Hours in Montevideo, Uruguay
abstract: The city is home to charming small museums, a lively old city and only a handful of tourists.

title: 36 Hours in Sacramento
abstract: This capital city has a gentle, small-town charm, with a strong theater tradition, delightful new restaurants and a vibrant art scene.
